title: Thirteen
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, empty mid-century office tower at night, flickering fluorescent green-white light, long polished corridors and brass elevator doors, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. The building has twelve floors. The elevator goes to thirteen. 🛗

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: The Harrow Tower has twelve floors. The elevator has a button for thirteen.
scenes.image: a brass elevator button panel in an empty office lobby at night, one button glowing at the very top

scenes.narration: Tess Varga took the night security job for the quiet. Midnight to eight. One desk. A wall of cameras. A coffee machine that whimpers.
scenes.image: a woman security guard at a lobby desk at night, a wall of dim monitors showing grey hallways, marble floor

scenes.narration: On her first night, the day guard pointed at the elevator. That button. Don't press it. If it lights up, don't ride it. Just write it down.
scenes.image: an older security guard in uniform pointing toward polished brass elevator doors, fluorescent light

scenes.narration: She laughed. He didn't. He handed her the keys and left so fast he forgot his coat.
scenes.image: a guard's uniform coat left hanging on a chair behind an empty security desk at night

scenes.narration: Every hour, Tess walks the floors. Dark cubicles. Humming vending machines. Chairs pushed in. Nobody.
scenes.image: a woman with a flashlight walking through a dark open-plan office, rows of empty desks

scenes.narration: At 1:13 AM, she was back in the lobby when the elevator chimed.
scenes.image: an empty marble office lobby at night, the elevator doors lit from above, a security guard turning toward them

scenes.narration: Nobody in the building. Nobody badged in. But the doors slid shut, and the car began to rise.
scenes.image: polished brass elevator doors sliding closed in an empty lobby at night, a sliver of light between them

scenes.narration: She watched the floor lights climb. Ten. Eleven. Twelve.
scenes.image: a row of small round lights glowing one after another above elevator doors, no numerals, dark lobby

scenes.narration: Then one more light came on. Above twelve. A light that should not exist.
scenes.image: close-up of a single extra light glowing above an old elevator door, brighter than the rest

scenes.narration: The car came back down. The doors opened. Empty. But it smelled like cigarettes and carbon paper. And the button for thirteen was still lit. Waiting for her.
scenes.image: an open empty elevator car with wood paneling and a haze of old smoke, one button glowing on the panel
